posts.title: MicroLighter is Living Span-Free In My <head>
posts.description: I'm really excited for MicroLighter - the new syntax highlighter from Dave Rupert. I've switched over this blog to use it. I've used a number of syntax highlighters over the years, Pygments, Rogue, Prism, Shiki. posts.title: My house alerts me when my cat climbs into the ceiling
posts.description: We have an orange cat who loves to climb into our basement's drop ceiling and wander around. It's especially adorable when she hangs out in an alcove and surveys her domain. posts.title: The Year Of The Linux Desktop (for fitness games)
posts.description: A tale told in memes I'm joining the bandwagon and declaring that 2026 will be the Year of the Linux Desktop. Specifically for the subset of fitness gaming apps, it's no longer necessary (or preferred) to be tethered to Windows. Two long-term trends have led to this moment.
